phrases.english: Swim on your back, like an otter.

lutra.html: Why lutra, not lūtra: Lewis & Short prints a long u but gives no evidence, and its only etymological note, luō, has a short one. De Vaan (2008: 355) prints lutra, from PIE *ud-ro- “of the water”, with the short u of Sanskrit udrá- and Greek ὕδρος; Italian and Portuguese lontra and French loutre continue a short u.
